output.summary: The record FY2026 result mostly reflects the commodity price rally. Bushels were flat, handling revenue was flat, and the cooperative ranked mid-pack against peers, none of whom adopted a program like Operational Excellence. The 6% cost-per-bushel gain comes entirely from cutting maintenance. Deferred work orders tripled, the insurer found critical dust and monitoring failures at Harlan Junction, and a hot-bearing near-miss was closed with no SP-04 investigation. Drying and grading know-how sits with one retiring superintendent and has no documentation or successor. The expansion case assumes peak prices and unsourced volume growth. Fix the Harlan hazards and start succession work now, and defer the vote until the case is rebuilt on normalized prices.
